name: Amikacin
executiveSummary: Aminoglycoside. Adult **15 mg/kg IV every 24 h** (once-daily; usual max 1.5 g/day). Pediatrics 15 mg/kg/day; CF up to 30 mg/kg/day. Monitor levels and renal/auditory toxicity.
indications:
## Indications

- Severe gram-negative infections resistant to gentamicin/tobramycin, including some *Pseudomonas* and Enterobacterales.
- CF, nontuberculous mycobacteria (combination regimens).

## Precautions

- Nephro/ototoxicity — level monitoring mandatory in prolonged therapy or renal failure.
- Adjust interval in renal failure. Incompatible with penicillins in the same line.

> Infuse ≥ 30–60 min.

adulto.dose: Once-daily: **15 mg/kg IV every 24 h** (usual max **1.5 g/day**). Every-12-h alternative: **7.5 mg/kg every 12 h**. CF / high: up to **20–30 mg/kg/day** under ID with levels. MAC: **7.5–15 mg/kg/day**.
adulto.administration: IV diluted 30–60 min in NS/5% dextrose. IM possible.
adulto.notes: Level targets per local protocol (peak/trough or AUC).

pediatrico.dose: **15 mg/kg/day every 12–24 h** (max **1.5 g/day**). CF: **30 mg/kg/day every 24 h**. MAC: **7.5–15 mg/kg/day**.
pediatrico.notes: Dose by weight; obesity: adjusted weight per protocol.

neonatal.dose: Orientative: **15 mg/kg/dose every 24–48 h** by postmenstrual age.
neonatal.notes: NNU table + levels; long intervals in preterms.

stability:
## Stability

- Extemporaneous dilution; do not mix with beta-lactams in the same syringe.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, neuromuscular blockade (rare), rash.
